exercises.answer: javac lets you jit — see chapter section 1.2.

tests.instructions: One assessment per chapter grouping plus a final exam. Every question maps to the section shown in brackets so you can revise precisely.

questions.q: Which concept makes javac behave that way? (Java ch.1)
The worked sample prints "Hello, Java". Which statement caused it? (ch.1)
Which concept makes class behave that way? (Java ch.2)

Which concept makes List behave that way? (Java ch.3)

Which concept makes filter behave that way? (Java ch.4)
The worked sample prints "Sum of all prices after conversion". Which statement caused it? (ch.4)
Which concept makes try-with-resources behave that way? (Java ch.5)

Which concept makes ExecutorService behave that way? (Java ch.6)
